question: Who directed the film 'Tanvi The Great' at the 78th Cannes Film Festival?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Anupam Kher**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Anupam Kher**, the renowned Indian actor, made his directorial return with the film **'Tanvi The Great'**.
 
• The film was showcased at the **78th Cannes Film Festival**, highlighting Kher’s versatility beyond acting.
 
• This marks a significant directorial effort by Anupam Kher after many years, bringing a poignant story to an international audience.
 
• The film revolves around strong emotional and cultural themes, resonating with both Indian and global viewers.
 
• Kher’s storytelling and direction received critical praise, positioning him as a multidimensional talent in world cinema.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Anupam Kher** is an acclaimed Indian actor with over 500 films to his credit across multiple languages.
 
• He has previously served as the **Chairman of the Film and Television Institute of India (FTII)**.
 
• Kher has received multiple national and international awards, including the **Padma Bhushan and Padma Shri**.
 
• **'Tanvi The Great'** reflects his continued evolution as a filmmaker, actor, and cultural ambassador.
 
• The film's screening at Cannes showcases **India’s growing influence in international cinema**.
